diagnosis: The best code is deeply jammed: over 1,100 pairs are tied within numerical precision of the maximum, giving most non-rattlers roughly 20 contacts when only 11 tangent directions need constraining, so the trust-region LP can only shave off $2.6\times10^{-9}$. The eight zero-contact rattlers are the key structural defect: they sit in unused holes while the other 181 points form an over-rigid core, meaning the configuration wastes points and volume instead of having every point active in a connected, balanced contact graph. Random kicks, rattler teleports, and short anneals followed by greedy LP polishing either relax back into this same basin or are too destructive to find a better one, and several attempts exceeded the time limit and were discarded entirely. A better optimum likely requires the core to expand into the rattlers' holes until all 189 points share the maximal load, which needs a deliberate topology change rather than more local polishing.
